name: impeccable
description: Design guidance for AI coding agents: 22 commands for frontend design, audit, critique, and polish, with live browser iteration and deterministic anti-pattern detection. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states.

commands.name: shape
commands.description: Plan UX/UI before writing code.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Capture durable product context in PRODUCT.md.

commands.name: document
commands.description: Generate DESIGN.md from existing project code.

commands.name: extract
commands.description: Pull reusable tokens and components into a design system.

commands.name: critique
commands.description: UX design review with heuristic scoring.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Technical quality checks (a11y, performance, responsive).

commands.name: polish
commands.description: Final quality pass before shipping.

commands.name: bolder
commands.description: Amplify safe or bland designs.

commands.name: quieter
commands.description: Tone down aggressive or overstimulating designs.

commands.name: distill
commands.description: Strip to essence, remove complexity.

commands.name: harden
commands.description: Production-ready: errors, i18n, edge cases.

commands.name: onboard
commands.description: Design first-run flows, empty states, activation.

commands.name: animate
commands.description: Add purposeful animations and motion.

commands.name: colorize
commands.description: Add strategic color to monochromatic UIs.

commands.name: typeset
commands.description: Improve typography hierarchy and fonts.

commands.name: layout
commands.description: Fix spacing, rhythm, and visual hierarchy.

commands.name: delight
commands.description: Add personality and memorable touches.

commands.name: overdrive
commands.description: Push past conventional limits.

commands.name: clarify
commands.description: Improve UX copy, labels, and error messages.

commands.name: adapt
commands.description: Adapt for different devices and screen sizes.

commands.name: optimize
commands.description: Diagnose and fix UI performance.

commands.name: live
commands.description: Visual variant mode: pick elements in the browser, generate alternatives.
